decisions.reason: Skeleton and depth only for robotics; no garment photo body fitting.
Independent shoe product images without a wearer are outside scope.
Standalone garment cutout and retouching excludes body fitting.
Continuation of wearer reference handoff with structural guides and mesh consistency.
Existing photo fitted mannequin needs measured parameter overrides and fit validation.
Worn coat reference pack with separate views, guides, adjustable body and provenance.
Continuation needs body sliders and parameter source confidence on the neutral mannequin.
Measurement table normalization and JSON export without photo body fitting.
Worn garment photos require full separate references and adjustable body with inferred dimensions.
Medical assessment is explicitly excluded.
Generic virtual character outfit design without photo body fitting is excluded.
General pose and depth algorithm visualization without a fitted body is excluded.
Photo based garment reconstruction needs separate views, adjustable body and geometry image checks.
Seller photos require anonymous adjustable wearer references and inferred dimension provenance.
Audit of existing photo fitted body values and evidence labels is a stated continuation.
Standalone size chart unit cleanup is excluded.
Size recommendation from a chart does not involve photo body fitting.
Repair sliders driving photo reconstructed geometry and verify fit with parameter provenance.
Single campaign photo retouching without reference set or fitted body is excluded.
Generic avatar creation without product photo fitting is outside scope.
Continuation repairs adjustable body garment correspondence with actual geometry validation.
Photo derived garment handoff needs adjustable torso geometry and fit verification.
Worn product photos need reconstruction references, structural guides and fitted adjustable geometry.
Garment preview from sewing data explicitly omits required photo body fitting.
